rules.rule: Preserve immutable original publication/confirmation intent after uncertain transport or malformed result. Valid committed receipt returns to original record; publication never fabricates formal order success.
rules.source: Approved existing failure-retry/no-duplicate UX and user via Dot C/D/E recovery repair. Original confirmation kept key but only replayed writes; publication had no equivalent pending guard. Shared DevelopmentCreateForm serves new create, Resume and original designer confirm; current UI norm specifies read-first safe recovery, not global retries.
rules.initialization: No automatic retry or new persistent browser/customer-data store. Capture cloned original body/key in same page; preserve leave/unload guard and original source links. New and resumed create use same pending state. Read failure or unavailable receipt retains inputs/key, not another source/order; explicit replay uses original command transaction/idempotency guards. Receipt recovered publication returns original source for later normal customer confirmation.

Existing real business validation, optional sample-date semantics, current actor scopes and source-order uniqueness unchanged.
